---
title: "Icon families"
format: html
filters:
  - value-box
---

Exercises every branch of the icon handling. Several families appear more
than once on purpose: the stylesheet for a family must be linked exactly
once however many boxes use it.

## Bootstrap Icons (three boxes, one stylesheet)

::: {.value-box icon="bi-star" value="1"}
Bootstrap one
:::

::: {.value-box icon="bi-arrow-down-up" value="2"}
Bootstrap two
:::

::: {.value-box icon="bi-heart" value="3"}
Bootstrap three
:::

## Font Awesome (two styles, one stylesheet)

::: {.value-box icon="fa-solid fa-clipboard" value="4"}
Font Awesome solid
:::

::: {.value-box icon="fa-brands fa-python" value="5"}
Font Awesome brands
:::

## Material Symbols (two families, two stylesheets)

::: {.value-box icon="home" icon-type="material" value="6"}
Material outlined
:::

::: {.value-box icon="star" icon-type="material" value="7"}
Material outlined again — same family, must not add a second link
:::

::: {.value-box icon="home" icon-type="material-rounded" value="8"}
Material rounded — a distinct family, so a distinct link
:::

## Tabler (two boxes, one stylesheet)

::: {.value-box icon="ti-star" value="9"}
Tabler one
:::

::: {.value-box icon="ti-heart" value="10"}
Tabler two
:::

## Phosphor (two weights, two stylesheets)

::: {.value-box icon="ph ph-star" value="11"}
Phosphor regular
:::

::: {.value-box icon="ph ph-heart" value="12"}
Phosphor regular again — same weight, must not add a second link
:::

::: {.value-box icon="ph-bold ph-heart" value="13"}
Phosphor bold — a distinct weight, so a distinct stylesheet
:::
